reason: I scrolled past it. I don't run a shop with an M-Pesa till, so the cover is a problem I don't have, and it's labelled a concept, not a product. Even if I did run a till, my first thought is that this is probably too expensive for a team like ours.
objection: I would have to give a studio I've never heard of read access to my payment statements. Who holds that data, and what happens when the feed breaks at closing time?
would_change_my_mind: A live product with a free trial, a named M-Pesa integration, and a demo run on a real till that shows the reply in two seconds.
